name: @sig-net/midnight-responder
description: The Sig Network response contract on Midnight: the circuits the MPC posts signature responses and remote execution attestations through, as contract events clients poll. Its proving artifacts are MinoCrab-compiled. src/index.ts is the curated export surface.

scripts.compile:zk: yarn compile && cd minocrab && cargo run --locked -- ../src/managed
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && ls src/managed/keys/*.prover >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'signet-responder build: no prover keys in src/managed/keys, run `yarn compile:zk` first (compile uses --skip-zk)' >&2; exit 1; } && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mkdir -p dist/managed && cp -R src/managed/contract src/managed/compiler src/managed/zkir src/managed/keys dist/managed/
